summary: One adversarial round on the Phase 7R head b5cab6da (dashboard/scripts/rebuild-map.ts, dashboard/__tests__/rebuild-map.test.ts, docs/content-plans/data/rebuild-map-levels-5-9.json). 10 new tests in dashboard/__tests__/rebuild-map.adversarial.test.ts close review A F1 and F2 and review B F1 and F2 as tests, plus 4 risk edges. A-F1 closes: a default-input run through the script's own folder reader writes the committed map byte for byte, and the mutant proof shows that Green mutant d (a reversed reader order) now fails that named test (before this round the mutant survived gate 1 because the Red file enumerates the folders itself). A-F2 closes: a level with more kept ids than packages throws from buildRebuildMap and main exits 2 with no write. Two defects route to Green. DEFECT-1 (review B F1): a --duplicates file with no groups key, or with an empty groups array, is accepted: main returns 0 and overwrites the existing out file with an empty map; both new tests fail at b5cab6da. DEFECT-2 (review B F2): a --out-json whose parent folder does not exist raises an uncaught ENOENT from the write at rebuild-map.ts:231 instead of the exit 2 path; the new test fails at b5cab6da. The combined run gives 30 passed and 3 failed (exactly the defect tests); the Red file keeps its 23 passes. A missing keep key in a group is pinned as current behavior (the map row holds the string 'undefined'), uncontracted by the plan and the strategy.
blocking_findings: DEFECT-1 [Major] review-b F1 for Green: tests 'rejects a duplicates file with no groups key: exit 2, out file byte-identical' and 'rejects a duplicates file with an empty groups array: exit 2, out file byte-identical' (dashboard/__tests__/rebuild-map.adversarial.test.ts) fail at b5cab6da with 'expected +0 to be 2': readKeepGroups defaults a missing groups key to an empty array (dashboard/scripts/rebuild-map.ts:94), no check rejects zero kept ids, main writes an empty map (0 map rows, 550 newIds rows over the real content root) over the existing --out-json and returns 0. A wrong input file therefore replaces the Phase 7 injector input and reports success. The test-strategy Phase 7R risks cover this: the 7R.5 table row 'A missing kept id' (an empty map drops every kept id of every level) and the row 'Count mismatch' (kept 0 against the keep counts 50, 88, 4, 38, 49 that 7R.3 pins). Fix in dashboard/scripts/rebuild-map.ts: reject a duplicates input with no groups key or an empty groups array before the write: print the message then the usage to stderr, return 2, write nothing, leave the out file untouched.

DEFECT-2 [Major] review-b F2 for Green: test 'exits 2 when the out folder does not exist, with no stack trace, and writes nothing' (dashboard/__tests__/rebuild-map.adversarial.test.ts) fails at b5cab6da with an uncaught 'ENOENT: no such file or directory' raised from fs.writeFileSync at dashboard/scripts/rebuild-map.ts:231: the write sits outside the try block of main (lines 224 to 230), so a missing parent folder raises with a stack trace instead of the documented exit 2 ('2 when the options or the input fail', rebuild-map.ts:208). Fix in dashboard/scripts/rebuild-map.ts: cover the write in the error path; print the message then the usage to stderr, return 2, write nothing.
nonblocking_findings: F3 [Nit] adversarial-testing: a duplicates group with no keep key maps to the keep id string 'undefined' (dashboard/scripts/rebuild-map.ts:94, String(group.keep) of an absent key). Pinned as current behavior by test 'maps a group with no keep key to the keep id "undefined" (current behavior; uncontracted)' (dashboard/__tests__/rebuild-map.adversarial.test.ts): exit 0, one map row { level: 5, keepId: 'undefined', package: 'quest-5/l01' }, no newIds row. The plan and the strategy state no rule for a missing keep key. A later hardening may reject it; that change must then update this test with a plan line.

A-F2 closed: tests 'throws from buildRebuildMap when a level has more kept ids than packages' and 'exits 2 from main and writes no file when a level has more kept ids than packages' pass at b5cab6da (2 keeps over 1 package: the guard at rebuild-map.ts:183 to 185 fires, main exits 2, no write, no stack line).

DEFECT-1 proven: the two B-F1 tests fail at b5cab6da with 'expected +0 to be 2' (combined capture adversarial-7r-b5cab6da.txt, failures 1 and 2 of 3); the sentinel out file is overwritten by the current main.
DEFECT-2 proven: the B-F2 test fails at b5cab6da with the uncaught ENOENT from Module.main scripts/rebuild-map.ts:231 (combined capture, failure 3 of 3).

Risk edges pass at b5cab6da: an unknown level (level 4 in a group) exits 2 and leaves an existing sentinel out file untouched; the same keep id in two groups of different levels is rejected (exit 2, no write) by the repeated-keep guard at rebuild-map.ts:157; a duplicates file that is not valid JSON exits 2 with the message then the usage and no stack line, out file untouched; a group with no keep key maps to keepId 'undefined' (current behavior, uncontracted, pinned).

Regression: the combined heavy-run holds the Red file's 23 tests as well; the only failures in the whole run are the 3 defect tests, so the Phase 7R contract and the committed map stand at this head (capture adversarial-7r-b5cab6da.txt: 'Tests 3 failed | 30 passed (33)', 'Test Files 1 failed | 1 passed (2)').
